about.title: About the data
about.lead: Where the PDPSI data comes from, how the figures are calculated, and the limitations to know before using it.
about.purposeBody: PDPSI publishes Indonesia's Social Forestry approval and designation records so they are easy to search, compare across regions, and download for research or presentations. PDPSI is a data publication portal. Applications, verification, and decree issuance remain in GoKUPS and other official government systems.
about.sourceBody: All records come from the Social Forestry register and decree detail pages in GoKUPS, retrieved on {date}. At that time GoKUPS reported {reported} decrees, and {rows} rows were retrieved.
about.sourcePeriod: Decree dates in this data range from {from} to {to}.
about.sourceUpdate: PDPSI is not connected to GoKUPS directly. The manager imports new data in a controlled way, and each import becomes a numbered release. Release shown: {version}, built {built}.
about.unitBody: One record is one row in the GoKUPS register: one Social Forestry approval or one Hutan Adat (customary forest) designation. PDPSI figures therefore count decree records, not groups or institutions.
about.unitHtr: Some Hutan Tanaman Rakyat records are individual permits, so one record can be one individual permit holder.
about.unitShared: One decree number can be used by several records, and one institution can appear under more than one decree number. PDPSI does not merge such records.
about.schemesLead: Summaries use five PS types. The definitions below are summaries; the official reference is Minister of Environment and Forestry Regulation No. 9 of 2021 on Social Forestry Management. Scheme names are kept in Indonesian.

def.HD: Hutan Desa (village forest): forest area without an existing permit, managed by a village for the village's welfare.
def.HKM: Hutan Kemasyarakatan (community forestry): forest area used mainly to empower local communities.
def.HTR: Hutan Tanaman Rakyat (community plantation forest): plantation forest in production forest, established by community groups or individuals to improve the forest's potential and quality.
def.HA: Hutan Adat (customary forest): forest within the territory of a customary law community. PDPSI records it as a designation, not an approval.
def.KK: Kemitraan Kehutanan (forestry partnership): cooperation between local communities and forest managers or permit holders in forest areas. The source records it in three subtypes, always shown separately:

kkSub.KK_KULIN: Kulin KK (recognition and protection of forestry partnerships)

about.processingFidelity: Source values are not changed. Names, decree numbers, dates, areas, and member counts appear as recorded, including their spelling and spacing. Empty cells are labelled not available, and a 0 stays 0.
about.processingDerived: PDPSI adds a few processed columns. In downloads they are prefixed [Olahan PDPSI] or [Pemeriksaan PDPSI]:
about.processingRegion: official region codes from Minister of Home Affairs Decree No. 300.2.2-2138 of 2025 for every province and regency/city. All {pairs} name pairs in the source matched, and the codes are identical to the 2023 BIG (Geospatial Information Agency) boundary data. The matching has not yet been checked manually.
about.processingJenis: PS type and record type (approval or designation);
about.processingYear: decree year, from the decree date column;
about.processingFlags: review notes and links between records that share a decree number.
about.numbersLabel: All aggregate figures are processed by PDPSI from the source records and are not official national figures. Every figure can be reproduced by filtering records on the Data page.
about.numbersRecords: Records: every record is counted, including records that share a decree number. Total {records}.
about.numbersArea: Area: sum of the Luas Area Keseluruhan (Ha) column over records where the value is present and not negative. Total {area} ha from {used} records. Records with an area-difference note are still counted.
about.numbersMembers: Members: sum of men + women over records where both values are present and not negative, including those that add up to 0. Total {members} from {used} records; {notUsed, plural, one {# record is} other {# records are}} not counted because of a negative value.
about.numbersSourceTotal: The source column Anggota Keseluruhan (total members) sums to {sourceTotal} and is kept for comparison. It is not used to count members, because in {mismatch} records it equals the number of women.
about.duplicatesBody: {groups} decree numbers are used by more than one record, {records} records in total. All of them are kept and counted. Each carries a Duplicate label with links to the other records that share its decree number.
about.duplicatesTypes: {identical} records are identical to another record apart from the row number. The other {differs} share a decree number but differ in content, such as institution, region, or area.
about.duplicatesSpacing: Another {count} records have a decree number that differs from another record only in spacing or letter case. PDPSI does not treat them as the same, but links them.
about.checksLead: PDPSI checks every record and adds a note when values are inconsistent. Notes do not change source values. Select a count to see the records concerned.
about.limitsHomepage: PDPSI figures differ from the achievement figures on the GoKUPS home page. According to the source workbook notes, on {homeDate} the GoKUPS home page showed {homeInstitutions} institutions and {homeArea} ha, while the retrieved register contained {records} decrees and {area} ha. GoKUPS does not explain the difference.
about.limitsRounding: Areas in the source are rounded to whole hectares.
about.limitsFemale: The number of women is 0 in {pct}% of records, including almost all decrees before 2017. These zeros probably mean the value was not recorded. PDPSI does not yet publish statistics comparing men and women.
about.limitsRecent: There are far fewer records dated {lastYears} than in earlier years ({recent}). Data for the most recent years is probably incomplete in the source.
about.limitsDistrict: Districts (kecamatan) are shown as source text and are not yet matched to official codes.
about.limitsRegion: The Region column in the workbook is not a GoKUPS field. The workbook compiler derived it from the province name.
about.mapBody: The dataset has no location coordinates for groups. The PDPSI map will therefore only show counts per province and regency/city on administrative boundaries, without location points. The map is not shown yet because permission to use the boundary data is still being confirmed.
about.excludedBody: The Ketua Lembaga (chair), Pra-Pendamping, and Pendamping (facilitator) columns contain personal names. They are not shown until their legal basis, purpose, and privacy risk have been reviewed. The public PDPSI data is therefore not a complete raw copy.

flags.duplicate_sk: The decree number is also used by other records.
flags.duplicate_identical: Identical to another record with the same decree number.
flags.duplicate_attributes_differ: Shares a decree number with another record, but other columns differ.
flags.sk_spacing_variant: Decree number differs from another record only in spacing or letter case.
flags.sk_year_truncated: The year in the decree number has 3 digits.
flags.date_after_extraction: Decree date is later than the data retrieval date.
flags.date_year_mismatch: The year in the decree number differs from the year of the decree date.
flags.area_zero: Total area in the source is 0.
flags.area_component_mismatch: Total area differs by more than 5 ha from the sum of area components. The area is still counted.
flags.area_component_rounding: Total area differs by 1 to 5 ha from the sum of area components. The area is still counted.
flags.area_missing: Total area is empty in the source.
flags.area_negative: Total area is negative in the source.
flags.members_total_column_mismatch: Anggota Keseluruhan (total members) does not equal men + women.
flags.members_total_equals_female: Anggota Keseluruhan (total members) equals the number of women.
flags.members_component_missing: Men or women count is empty in the source.
flags.institution_type_lphd_on_htr: Institution type recorded as Lembaga Pengelola Hutan Desa (village forest institution) under the Hutan Tanaman Rakyat scheme.
flags.kph_bengkulu_utara_outside_bengkulu: Forest management unit recorded as KPHP Bengkulu Utara for a record outside Bengkulu Province; needs confirmation from the GoKUPS operator.
